title: Qubit-ADAPT-VQE: An Adaptive Algorithm for Constructing Hardware-Efficient Ansatze on a Quantum Processor
problem_summary: Extends ADAPT-VQE with a qubit-excitation-based operator pool (rather than fermionic), drastically reducing circuit depth; proves a minimal pool size scaling linearly with qubit count still guarantees the ability to construct exact ansatze.
